Step.Text: ── 1b. NIVELACIJE before datumOd. Without this the opening balance is wrong from the first row: a nivelacija raises or lowers the retail value of stock already carried, so a period that opens after one must inherit its effect. Signed sum — a price reduction carries a negative UkupnoRazlika and correctly reduces the donos. Zero-effect (hold-the-price) documents contribute nothing and need no filtering. ──
